request.style: English, male solo voice with warm alto choir, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, organ, solemn and majestic mood, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Do not be quickly shaken in mind
Nor alarmed by a spirit or word
Let no one deceive you in any way
The day of the Lord is not yet here

[Verse]
First comes the rebellion and the fall
The man of lawlessness is revealed
The son of destruction opposes all
He exalts himself above the gods

[Verse]
He sits in the temple of God
Proclaiming himself to be divine
The mystery of lawlessness at work
Held back until the proper time

[Verse]
He comes by the working of Satan
With false signs and wicked deception
Aiming at those who refuse the truth
And delight in the ways of evil

[Verse]
But the Lord Jesus will destroy him
With the breath of his mouth to nothing
The splendor of his coming returns
To destroy the power of the lie

[Verse]
We thank God for you who are loved
Chosen as the firstfruits for salvation
Stand firm and hold fast to the truth
Loved by the Lord in every word

[Outro]
Comfort your hearts and strengthen you
